newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end lower, hit by BOE comments and Dow.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end lower, hit by BOE comments and Dow.

text.p: UK shares ended mostly weaker on Tuesday, dragged downwards by falling bonds, a weaker Dow and a call for a higher interest rates from the Bank of England's deputy governor.
The FTSE 100 index of leading shares closed 27.7 points down at 4,078.8, just above the day's low, with decliners in a seven-to-two majority. The Dow was off 48 points as London closed.

"We seem to be ignoring the Dow on the upside but following it on the downside," said Philip Isherwood, strategist at Kleinwort Benson. "Bonds weakened over lunchtime and the Dow has come back a long way from yesterday's high."
